definitions.explanation: A relationship, connection, or bond between people, things, or concepts. Can refer to personal relationships, logical connections, or organizational ties.

examples.japanese: {人|ひと}との{繋|つな}がりを{大切|たいせつ}にする。
この{二|ふた}つの{事件|じけん}には{繋|つな}がりがある。
examples.english: There is a connection between these two incidents.

examples.japanese: SNSを{通|つう}じて{世界中|せかいじゅう}の{人|ひと}と{繋|つな}がりを{持|も}てるようになった。
examples.english: Through social media, it has become possible to form connections with people around the world.

notes:
KANJI: Also written as {繋|つな}がり. The kanji {繋|つな}ぐ means "to connect, to tie."

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {人|ひと}との{繋|つな}がり: connections with people
- {繋|つな}がりがある: there is a connection
- {繋|つな}がりを{持|も}つ: to have a connection/tie
- {繋|つな}がりを{大切|たいせつ}にする: to value connections
- {地域|ちいき}の{繋|つな}がり: community ties

RELATED VERB: {繋|つな}がる (to be connected, to be linked) is the intransitive verb from which this noun derives.
